FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Alaska fishing licence

Non-residents aged 16 or older need a sport fishing licence. A king salmon stamp is normally required even when you release the fish.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-12

Who needs one

  • Non-residents aged 16 or older.
  • Residents aged 18 or older, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Non-residents under 16; harvest records can still apply.
  • Resident seniors aged 60 or older with the required ADF&G identification card.

Extra stamps and permits

  • Non-resident king salmon stamp, 1-day · $15 USD
    Required to fish for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.
  • Sport Fishing Harvest Record Card · $0 USD
    Required for licence-exempt anglers in fisheries with annual harvest limits.
  • Non-resident king salmon stamp, 3-day · $30 USD
    Required when fishing for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.
  • Non-resident king salmon stamp, 7-day · $45 USD
    Required when fishing for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.
  • Non-resident king salmon stamp, 14-day · $75 USD
    Required when fishing for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.
  • Non-resident king salmon stamp, annual · $100 USD
    Required when fishing for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.

Saltwater

The sport fishing licence covers fresh and salt water.

Rules visitors should know

  • Record catches subject to annual harvest limits.
  • Annual licences and annual king salmon stamps follow the calendar year.

How to buy

Buy through ADF&G's online licence service or a licence vendor.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Alaska?

Non-residents aged 16 or older need a sport fishing licence. A king salmon stamp is normally required even when you release the fish.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Alaska?

Non-resident 1-day: $15 USD; Non-resident 3-day: $30 USD; Non-resident 7-day: $45 USD; Non-resident 14-day: $75 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Alaska?

Buy through ADF&G's online licence service or a licence vendor.
